chapter.verse: Kitawng kawmin pawipi sungah an nekna sangin, lungnuam takin moh keu themkhat nekna hoihzaw hi.
A pil silapa in a topa’ ta hai tungah aana nei-in, a topa’ gamh pawlkhat a luah hi.
Kham leh ngunte, mei sungah kize-et a, mihingte’ lungsim, Topa in ze-et hi.
Migilote in gitlohna thu mah ngaih-in nei a, zuautheite in zuauthu mah ngaih-in nei hi.
A zawngte a simmawhpa in amah a Piangsakpa a simmawh hi a, midangte tuahsiatna-ah a lungdam mipa in daan tuak hamtang ding hi.
Tute in puteekte’ minthan’na lukhu hi a, pate in tate’ minthan’na ahi hi.
Miliante in zuauthu gen ngei lo a, mihaite in na-a kimang kampau ngei lo hi.
Sumgolh a zangte in ai bangin ngaihsun uh a, a deih khempeuh uh a ngah sak dingin ngaihsun uh hi.
Mi’ khialhna a maisakte, midangte in it-in lawm hau uh a, mi’ khialhna ciamtehna in lawm taanna hi.
Mihai khat, zavei a kisatna sangin, mipil khat, khatvei taina in bunzaw hi.
Thusia bekbek a deih tawntung migilote kiangah, a gilo kamtaipa bangin sihna tung ding hi.
Mihaite a hai gamtatna uh i tuah khak sangin, a no a kilaksak vompi hang khat tuak leeng hoihzaw lai hi.
Thuhoih kimlai thusia tawh a thukte’ inn sungah, cik mahin thusia veng cih om ngei lo hi.
Kitot i kipat ciangin tui lipi cin’na phung kehsak khak tawh kibang hi; tua ahih manin a nasiat ma-in kitot khawl pak in.
Migilote khahkhongna, leh thuman mite mawhsakna, a nih tuakin Topa in deih lo hi.
Mihaipa in thu ngaihsut theihna nei lo ahih manin, pilna zon’ nading sum tampi a zat hangin a phattuamna om lo hi.
Lawm citak in a tawntungin hong it a, i sanggamte in i lungkhamna hong thuakpih dinga piang ahi hi.
Thu a ngaihsun thei lo mihaite bek, midangte’ leiba lohsak dingin kipia ngam hi.
Khialh ding a utte, lungkham ding a ut hi a, kihisak-a paupaute, buaina zongzong ahi hi.
Lungsim hoih lote in lungdamna mu lo a, mi a khem theite in lungkhamna tuak hi.
Tapa hai in a pa’ lungkhamna hi a, tahai a neipa a lungdam lo hi.
Mai taii-na in ci damsak a, mai gum tawntungna in guhtui teep kang hi.
A ginalo thukhente in sumgolh sang sim uh a, a thukhenna uh ah thuman om nawn lo hi.
Mipilte in ahoih pen-a gamtat nading thei a, mihaite in a cih nading meel uh thei lo hi.
Ta hai in a pa dahsak a, a pian’na a nu zong lungkhamsak hi.
A thuman mi daan piak ding hoih lo a, mihoihte satna in thu-khialhna ahi hi.
Thu a thei taktakte in gengen khol lo a, a paupau khollote thu mu taktak hizaw hi.
Mihaite nangawn pau loin om leh a pil mah-in kingaihsun hi; thu ngaihsun thei na hihna a kilat nadingin pau loin om in.
